scientific_integrity: All-parameter claims follow from the analytic proof. Exact-rational sample checks are illustrative, not exhaustive or an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the iid bounded positive two-state random Markov cocycle, not the original interval map; finite-dimensional Gaussian convergence only. Related general diffusion-approximation priority remains to be checked independently.
title: Quenched fluctuations and a stationary Gaussian slow mode for two-state random metastable Markov cocycles
